title: Restore missing fixtures/flash8-empty.fla (breaks 14 core FLA-writer tests on fresh clone)
description: BLOCKER on fresh clones: fixtures/flash8-empty.fla is referenced by 8 files (packages/core/src/fla/write/{empty-templates,carchive-validate,timeline-write,contents-write}.ts and tests empty-bytematch/carchive-validate/writer-spec-bytes/contents-structure) but is NOT committed to the repo and NOT gitignored — it was simply never added. This causes ~14 ENOENT failures in 'pnpm --filter @flash/core run test -- --run'. The file is a genuine real-Flash-8 empty document (WIN 8,0,0,478; Contents=17312B, Page1=274B per CLAUDE.md). An agent CANNOT fabricate a byte-real Flash 8 file. RESOLUTION OPTIONS: (1) the author commits the real fixtures/flash8-empty.fla (preferred — it exists on the original author's machine); OR (2) if it cannot be supplied, guard the dependent tests to skip-with-clear-reason when the fixture is absent (matching the visual-oracle CI-skip pattern in CLAUDE.md) so a fresh clone is green — but do NOT weaken assertions when the fixture IS present. SEQUENCING: option (2) edits the external FLA-writer files that are under ACTIVE concurrent development; only pursue it once that work settles, to avoid prohibitive merge conflicts. DONE = fresh clone runs core suite with 0 ENOENT-for-flash8-empty failures. --- VERIFICATION 2026-06-22 (QA, HEAD 0a02a38) ---  STILL UNRESOLVED. Commit 3062115 ('add flash8-empty.fla', task 1207) committed a ZERO-BYTE placeholder, NOT the genuine Flash 8 doc. `ls -l fixtures/flash8-empty.fla` = 0 bytes; `git cat-file -s 3062115:fixtures/flash8-empty.fla` = 0; `file` reports 'empty' (no D0CF11E0 OLE2/CFB magic). Effect on gates: the prior ENOENT/collection-dark state is now EXECUTION FAILURES. `__readAllStreamsForTest` on a non-OLE2 0-byte buffer returns an empty Map (no throw), so the fixture-dependent gates collect+run but FAIL on undefined stream lookups: empty-bytematch.test.ts (5 fails: Contents/Page1 length expect 17312/274 vs fixture undefined; diffOffsets reads undefined.length; stream-key set [] vs ['Contents','Page 1']), carchive-validate.test.ts (1 fail: 'parses flash8-empty.fla Contents + Page 1 cleanly'), contents-structure.test.ts (1 fail: '1 CDocumentPage,1 CColorDef,1 CQTAudioSettings'). Full core suite: 3 files / 7 tests fail, 5528 pass. writer-spec-bytes.test.ts (4 tests) PASSES — it is structural/fixture-independent. KEY: this is NOT writer drift — the saveRealFla(emptyDoc()) 'out' side builds a valid 17312B Contents; every failure is the fixture side being undefined. RESOLUTION unchanged from original: the genuine ~17KB OLE2 fixture must be committed by the author (an agent cannot fabricate a byte-real Flash 8 file), OR guard the 3 fixture-dependent gates to skip-with-reason when the fixture is absent/0-byte. The dark-gate caveat (CLAUDE.md task 1207) is NOT cleared.
